subject: science
cluster: Living things, weather, and caring for Earth
skillName: Reducing Our Impact on the Environment

items.prompt:
People's actions can affect
A) the land, water, air, and living things
B) nothing
C) only the Moon
D) only rocks in space
items.answer: A) the land, water, air, and living things

items.prompt:
A solution to trash on the ground is to
A) pick it up and put it in a bin or recycle it
B) leave more trash
C) bury food in the park
D) ignore it
items.answer: A) pick it up and put it in a bin or recycle it

steps: Cleaning up protects the land and animals.

items.prompt:
Recycling helps because it
A) reuses materials and makes less trash
B) makes more trash
C) wastes water
D) pollutes the air
items.answer: A) reuses materials and makes less trash

steps: Recycling reduces waste and saves resources.

items.prompt:
One way to save water is to
A) leave the tap running
B) turn off the water when not using it
C) pour it out
D) waste it
items.answer: B) turn off the water when not using it

steps: Turning off the tap saves water.

items.prompt:
Planting trees helps the
A) air
B) trash
C) pollution grow
D) nothing

To communicate a solution means to
A) tell others about it
B) keep it secret
C) forget it
D) break it

steps: Communicating is sharing the solution with others.

items.prompt:
Why tell others about ways to help the environment?
A) To waste time
B) So more people help and make a bigger difference
C) To hide the solution
D) There is no reason
items.answer: B) So more people help and make a bigger difference

steps: More people helping protects the environment more.

items.prompt:
Which statement is correct?
A) Small actions by many people can make a big difference
B) One person can never help
C) Littering helps animals
D) Wasting water is good
items.answer: A) Small actions by many people can make a big difference

steps: Many people helping adds up to a big difference.
